item.content:encoded:
The current problems with Addendum 171-2 could actually be spun into something really interesting like researches or interview logs prior hinting at the fact that the foam is luring people into joining the collective consciousness. Then the addendum would make sense as it would make sense why people would want to dive headfirst into the foam (kind of like the mask or When Day Breaks). Because otherwise, it really wouldn't make sense why someone would want to join the foam other than insanity or religious practices.

Although, there are tons of scps that lure their victim into it, so this is just food for thought.

item.content:encoded: Addendum 171-2 should be removed because it doesn't make sense to allow that. I like the idea here, but I wish it was executed in a more interesting manner. I think I'll novote this one.

I ponder the below knowing full well we don't mix SCPs.

I wonder what would happen if you attached SCP-963 to the foam(without being on a host). Would a Bright imprint over the hivemind, have that instance of Bright become part of the hive mind, or nothing since the amulet has no nervous system?

What about seeing what would happen if a human host of Bright was integrated?
I've always liked this one.

This is awesome. Don't know if you want to integrate this information but here's the relevant national body which would probably get involved.

Communicable Diseases Network Australia (CDNA)

I'm only familiar with the Victorian protocols. NSW may be different.
